For each unique region in the data, create a sub-directory named after the region (e.g., 'by_region/North/', 'by_region/South/'). In each region directory, create a file called 'sales.csv' containing ONLY the rows for that region, with the same CSV header (product,quantity,price,region).

by_region/
├── North/sales.csv   (2 rows: Laptop, Mouse)
